next.reason: The 1985 diagram is read with §1985:VI.6.16.3 SR3 ('If the END-IF phrase is specified, the NEXT SENTENCE phrase must not be specified'): IF with statements closed by END-IF, or statements/NEXT SENTENCE with an ELSE alternative and no END-IF. §2023:14.9.19.2 prints exactly these as Format 1 (delimited) and 'Format 2 (historic)'; the ellipsis on statement-1/-2 is §2023:14.9.19.3 SR1 ('one or more imperative statements or a conditional statement optionally preceded by one or more imperative statements'). NEXT SENTENCE is only marked archaic. No program accepted by one edition is refused by the other. SR-14.9.19.3-3 (omitting ELSE NEXT SENTENCE before the period) carries 1985 SR2, not this format, so it is left out.
